# The tools that build the release packages (tests.yml, job "package"),
# pinned by hash so the published files are built with exactly these:
#     python -m pip install --require-hashes --no-deps -r .github/build-requirements.txt
#     python -m build --no-isolation --outdir dist .
# To update, change the versions and hashes together (the hashes of the
# py3-none-any wheels on PyPI); tests/test_workflows.py checks the format.
